propositions: Helper functions absent from KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS are silently skipped during env-var scanning, causing documented environment variables to be undocumented in the registry.
The generator fails closed for unrecognized os.environ accessors but fails open for unregistered env-read helpers, creating asymmetric failure modes for the same underlying hazard.

A parameterized-shim predicate (functions whose os.environ key expressions reference their own parameters) identifies 9 env-read helpers across 557 files, of which 3 are currently unregistered and cause 2 operator-settable vars to be missing from docs.
Registering _gate_str_pref reveals REBAR_GATE_REF and REBAR_GATE_SOURCE as undocumented despite being advertised to operators in CLI help and readable at src/rebar/_config_resolvers.py.
A regression from commit 269b4d5678 deleted _str_pref and introduced _gate_str_pref without updating KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS, causing the registry to drop two keys while --check remained green.

The fix must fail closed symmetrically: missing helper registrations must abort the scan naming the site, and test coverage must distinguish between pre-existing guards and new parameterized-shim detection.
